value.title: The Marvels
value.text: When Kree soldiers attack the Khan home, Aamir and Yusuf take one on together, until it punches Aamir and breaks his glasses. Later, on the S.A.B.E.R. station, Aamir teases his father for being nearly as old as a centuries-old alien.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Aamir's father. They take on a Kree soldier together.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Yusuf's son, who takes on a Kree soldier beside him, then teases him on the space station.

verdicts.why: They do share the Kree fight and the S.A.B.E.R. station teasing, but they do not fight the soldier off: Aamir hits it with a coat rack and the Kree gets the upper hand, punching him and breaking his glasses (the soldiers come out of Goose rather than bursting in).
New Life (S6E13): a Shrike infects Yo-Yo, Mack is handed the dagger but cannot kill her, she turns and attacks him, and after May kills Izel Mack holds her.
Adapt or Die (S7E6): Yo-Yo goes with Mack to rescue his parents in 1976, he introduces her as his girlfriend, and she comforts him when they turn out to be Chronicoms and his real parents dead.
Emancipation (S3E20): May flies Lash to Hive's hideout on a Quinjet; Lash frees Daisy, is killed by Hellfire, and May sits beside his body and mourns her ex-husband.

Infinity War: Banner reappears at the Compound after two years missing, Natasha greets him and Sam calls it awkward, and she tells him Clint and Scott are under house arrest. Friend fits, as they are no longer together.

The pager scene is real and credits scenes belong to their film, but the app orders Captain Marvel at 1995, before The Avengers, so this stage would become their first, ahead of Natasha recruiting Bruce, with text set after the Snap. Carol's pager-scene stages work because those ties start there; this one already starts at The Avengers. Options: add it at Captain Marvel anyway, or leave it out.
Ant-Man and the Wasp: Paxton and Maggie pick Cassie up from Scott's house, bring her back the next day for her soccer shoes, and at the end Cassie, Paxton and Maggie hug the freed Scott together.
Ant-Man and the Wasp: Maggie collects Cassie after her weekend at Scott's, helps her pack, and takes her back for her soccer shoes.
Ant-Man and the Wasp: Scott and Cassie play the cardboard-tunnel treasure game, and after the FBI leaves she says he needs a partner watching his back, meaning herself, and he refuses.
Endgame: Scott finds fifteen-year-old Cassie at her door and they share a tearful reunion; after the Blip they watch the fireworks with Hope.
The H Word (Defenders #1): Danny and Colleen are hunting the Hand in Cambodia when Shaft tells Danny the fight is in New York, and they fly back to the city together.

Ned overhears Liz's group talking about the Avengers and blurts in front of the whole class that Peter knows Spider-Man. It is a class scene and the remark is aimed at Liz, so he and Betty never actually deal with each other in Homecoming.

value.title: The Daily Bugle#14
value.text: Betty interviews Ned about Peter for The Daily Bugle, but her questions keep turning to their own past romance. It gets tense, though they still compliment each other.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Ex-boyfriend, whose interview turns into talk of their romance.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Ex-girlfriend, whose interview of him turns to their past romance.

verdicts.why: The theatrical film has no scene between them, but the interview is also The Daily Bugle TikTok 'a sit-down with Peter Parker's best friend, Ned Leeds', which the app already lists as The Daily Bugle#14 (Ned's appearance there). In it Betty's questions turn to their past romance; it gets tense, but they still compliment each other.
Endgame: Corvus reports that Nebula is not responding, and when Thanos orders him to rain fire he protests 'But, sire, our troops!' and then has the Sanctuary II fire.
Endgame: Thanos brings Cull through time and summons him to the Compound ruins, where he fights for Thanos until Giant-Man stomps him to death. That counts as acting for him.
Endgame: Maw examines the 2014 Nebula for Thanos, finds a second Nebula from nine years ahead, plays her memories, then chains her neck to execute her as a traitor until Thanos spares her.

New Life (S6E13, running #123): Simmons arrives with an upgraded Zephyr and saves May. Deke asks where Fitz is, and she says she doesn't know and can't know. Not the same episode as the tie's S5#14 stage.

Adapt or Die (S7E6): Deke shocks Enoch, thinking he is a traitor, while Enoch is implanting something in an unconscious Simmons. She reveals the D.I.A.N.A. implant that stops her knowing where Fitz is, and Deke agrees to keep the secret.

What We're Fighting For (S7E13): Fitz signals Deke to help with the Quantum Tunnel, Deke works out how to expand the bubble, and he volunteers to stay behind so the team can go home (Wikipedia's E13 summary agrees).
AKA Freak Accident (S2E2): Jessica calls Dorothy and then breaks in. Dorothy swings a golf club and misses, says Trish went to see Max Tatum, and Jessica scolds her for it.
S2E2: at lunch Trish asks Dorothy about Max Tatum; Dorothy calls out her lies and warns her off him, then gives her the information.

value.title: Avengers: Endgame
value.text: In 2014, Gamora watches as Ebony Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and then tries to execute Nebula as a traitor.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Adoptive sister, who watches him search Nebula's memories.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Adoptive brother, who tries to execute Nebula in front of her.

verdicts.why: On the Sanctuary II in 2014, Gamora is one of the few people in the room as Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and then chains Nebula to execute her. That is a small scene together while both serve Thanos, not a crowd scene.
Endgame: the 2014 Maw searches Nebula's memories for Thanos and shows him his future, follows him to 2023, alerts him that Barton has the gauntlet, and turns to dust in Stark's snap.

Vol. 3: the 2014 Gamora stayed in touch with Nebula, who brings her and the Ravagers in to break into the Orgoscope for Rocket. They fight together through the end, then Gamora leaves with the Ravagers and Nebula stays on Knowhere.
Endgame: the restored Groot reunites with Rocket in the battle, and when Groot is knocked back by a blast, Rocket tries to shield him from a turret aimed at them.
Love and Thunder, Battle of Indigarr: Groot and Rocket fight over the binoculars ('Oh, you got sap all over it').
Holiday Special: after the celebrations, Rocket has Groot stand like a Christmas tree while he and Cosmo decorate him, until Groot lowers his arms and the decorations fall.

Vol. 3: Groot sits by Rocket on the way to the Orgoscope, gets Theel's passkey with Quill on Counter-Earth and hugs the revived Rocket, joins Rocket's new Guardians, and they dance to 'Dog Days Are Over'.
Ant-Man and the Wasp: Hank and Hope build the tunnel to reach Janet and are arrested by the FBI together. Hope and Scott keep Ava busy while Hank enters the Quantum Realm and brings Janet back.
Quantumania: Hope, Hank and Janet are pulled in together, and Hope and Hank press Janet until she tells them about Kang. Hank later arrives leading the evolved ants, which overpower Kang.
Quantumania: aboard Krylar's ship Janet tells Hank and Hope about Kang. After the battle Janet fixes the power core and goes home through the portal with Hank.
